<\STATESEP>chapter "The API"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory API_H
imports Syscall_H Delete_H
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>consts'
kernelExitAssertions :: "kernel_state \<Rightarrow> bool"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>consts'
fastpathKernelAssertions :: "kernel_state \<Rightarrow> bool"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
callKernel :: "event \<Rightarrow> unit kernel"
where
"callKernel ev\<equiv> (do
    stateAssert fastpathKernelAssertions [];
    runExceptT $ handleEvent ev
        `~catchError~` (\<lambda> _. withoutPreemption $ (do
                      irq \<leftarrow> doMachineOp (getActiveIRQ True);
                      when (isJust irq) $ handleInterrupt (fromJust irq)
        od)
                                                                        );
    schedule;
    activateThread;
    stateAssert kernelExitAssertions []
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
